title: Education-centered critical policy analysis of AI: Ghana's AI strategy as a case
abstract: arXiv:2608.16910v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: National AI strategies increasingly guide governance, workforce development, innovation, and competitiveness, but less is known about how they frame education as a sector with pedagogical, cultural, ethical, and implementation demands. This study develops and applies an Education-Centered AI Policy Framework to analyze Ghana's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, 2025-2035. Using critical qualitative policy document analysis, we examined the strategy through six components: policy purpose, teacher agency and professional learning, curriculum and assessment, language and culture, responsible AI and learner protection, and participation and implementation governance. Findings show that Ghana's strategy is ambitious and timely, especially in its emphasis on AI literacy, youth skills, TVET, workforce readiness, rural outreach, local language data, inclusion, and responsible AI governance. translated_title: 以教育为中心的AI批判性政策分析：以加纳AI战略为例
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16910v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：国家AI战略日益引导治理、劳动力发展、创新和竞争力，但关于它们如何将教育视为具有教学、文化、伦理和实施需求的部门，知之甚少。本研究开发并应用了一个以教育为中心的AI政策框架，分析加纳2025-2035年国家人工智能战略。通过批判性定性政策文件分析，我们从六个组成部分审视了该战略：政策目的、教师能动性与专业学习、课程与评估、语言与文化、负责任AI与学习者保护、以及参与和实施治理。研究结果显示，加纳的战略雄心勃勃且及时，特别是在强调AI素养、青年技能、职业技术教育与培训、劳动力准备、农村覆盖、本地语言数据、包容性和负责任AI治理方面。然而，教育议程在实施层面更为突出。
tldr: 本研究提出并应用以教育为中心的AI政策框架，分析加纳国家AI战略，发现其教育议程在AI素养、技能和治理方面雄心勃勃，但实施细节和教师专业支持相对薄弱。
en_tdlr: This study develops and applies an education-centered AI policy framework to analyze Ghana's national AI strategy, revealing its ambitious education agenda in AI literacy and skills but weaker implementation and teacher support aspects.
